notes:
- Customer: mid-market product analytics platform, multiple product surfaces (in-app assistant, search, recommendation reranker).
- Came in via PLG trial (hosted API). Trial metrics: 30 days, ~12k sessions, avg tokens per session ~420, total tokens ~125M.
- Primary ask now: Dedicated capacity sizing + traffic forecast to present to procurement. Want predictable throughput and cost isolation.
- Performance targets quoted by PD: chat p50 < 150ms (token streaming acceptable), p95 < 450ms; reranker latency target < 120ms for top-K.
- Trial observed avg QPS ~110 during business hours, peak bursts to ~540 QPS during nightly analytics pipelines; concurrency observed ~36 average, spikes to ~120 during release events.
- Token mix observed in trial: ~20% short (<=64 tokens), ~60% medium (65-512 tokens), ~20% long (>512 tokens). Average token length ~420.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate. Will trade some latency for lower unit cost. Interested in quantization + mixed routing (high-cost model for assistant, low-cost for summarization).
- Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency for a subset of customer data. VPC option preferred for production.
- POC ask for Dedicated: estimate baseline capacity to handle steady qps 120 with headroom for 4x burst (peak 480-600), target concurrency headroom 100+, and token throughput ~150M tokens/month as starting point.
- SE notes: recommend 2 GPU pools (low-latency pool for chat, high-throughput pool for embeddings/rerank) + prefix caching for repeat queries. Suggest fallback policy to smaller quantized model to cut cost for non-critical routes.
- Quote from product lead: "We need predictable invoices and no surprises when spikes happen; can Redwood guarantee graceful fallback?"
- Next steps: Redwood to deliver Dedicated sizing report (incl. QPS sizing, concurrency, estimated nodes, cost model) by 2024-11-06; follow-up call with procurement week of 2024-11-11.
